		# First Past the Post (amendment_first_past_the_post): one of the two
		# largest parties, as te_fptp_effects.txt ranks them monthly. In place
		# of the party-size multipliers (the else_ifs below), so a major party
		# never fills up: each group joining first takes a little off instead.
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					has_variable = te_fptp_major_conservative_party
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_major_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_major_party_join"
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:number > 0 }
				add = {
					value = scope:number
					multiply = te_fptp_major_party_crowding_weight
					desc = "te_fptp_major_party_crowding"
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number = 1
				is_powerful = no
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
				desc = "from_influential_supporting_member"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number = 2
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.5
				desc = "from_two_prior_members"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number >= 3
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.0
				desc = "from_three_or_more_prior_members"
			}
		}
		# First Past the Post: any party but the two largest.
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					NOT = { has_variable = te_fptp_major_conservative_party }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_minor_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_minor_party_join"
			}
		}
	}
}

INJECT:fascist_party = {
	join_weight = {
		value = {
			value = -5
			desc = "base_value"
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					c:BIC ?= this
					is_subject = yes
					OR = {
						has_modifier = modifier_india_crown_rule
						has_modifier = modifier_india_company_rule
						has_modifier = modifier_india_company_rule_upgraded
					}
				}
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
					is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -100
				desc = "india_colonial_government"
			}
		}
		if = { # fascists and general racists love fascism
			limit = {
				leader ?= {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ethno_nationalist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_integralist
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_fascism"
			}
		}
		if = { # strong fascists love fascism even more
			limit = {
				is_powerful = yes
				leader ?= {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_integralist
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_fascism_powerful"
			}
		}
		if = { # fascism is a reactionary ideology
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_reactionary
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_reactionaries"
			}
		}
		if = { # conservative IG's will fall behind a stronger fascist party
			limit = {
				is_powerful = no
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
					is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
					is_interest_group_type = ig_petty_bourgeoisie
					is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
					is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
				}
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						is_powerful = yes
						leader ?= {
							OR = {
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_integralist
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_weak_conservatives_fascism"
			}
		}
		if = { # socialists and radicals won't join conservative parties
			limit = {
				leader ?= {
					OR = {
						has_socialist_ideology = yes
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_state_socialist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -20
				desc = "from_leftist"
			}
		}
		if = { # various progressives dislike fascism
			limit = {
				leader ?= {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_feminist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_reformer
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_abolitionist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_pacifist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_humanitarian
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_humanitarian_royalist
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -10
				desc = "from_progressive_fascism"
			}
		}
		if = { # Trade Unions usually dislike fascism
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
			}
			add = {
				value = -2
				desc = "from_trade_unions"
			}
		}
		if = { # free trade advocates don't love protectionism
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_free_trade
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -2
				desc = "from_market_liberal"
			}
		}
		if = { # moderates are scared of radical politics
			limit = {
				leader ?= {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_moderate
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -3
				desc = "from_moderate"
			}
		}
		if = { # corporatists fall in line if they don't have christian democrats
			limit = {
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						is_powerful = yes
						leader ?= {
							OR = {
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_integralist
							}
						}
					}
				}
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_corporatist
					leader ?= {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_corporatist_leader
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_corporatism"
			}
		}
		if = { # patriots are inclined towards fascism
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_military_absolutist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_patriotic
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_militarist
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 4
				desc = "from_patriot"
			}
		}
		if = { # anti-immigration alliance
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_no_migration_controls
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_no_migration_controls
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_migration_law"
			}
		}
		if = { # conservatives like police
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_technology_researched = law_enforcement
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_no_police
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_no_police
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_no_police"
			}
		}
		if = { # anti-peasant levies
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_peasant_levies
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_peasant_levies
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_peasant_levies"
			}
		}
		if = { # loyalist/proletarian/meritocratic alliance for tax reform
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					NOT = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_proportional_taxation
					}
				}
				law_enactment_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_lacking_tax_laws"
			}
		}
		if = { # authoritarians inclined towards fascism
			limit = {
				leader ?= {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_authoritarian
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_authoritarian"
			}
		}
		if = { # French Monarchists
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						leader ?= {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
						}
						owner.py:fascist_party ?= {
							any_member = {
								is_powerful = yes
								leader ?= {
									OR = {
										has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
										has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
					AND = {
						leader ?= {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
						}
						owner.py:fascist_party ?= {
							any_member = {
								is_powerful = yes
								leader ?= {
									OR = {
										has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
										has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
					AND = {
						leader ?= {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
						}
						owner.py:fascist_party ?= {
							any_member = {
								is_powerful = yes
								leader ?= {
									OR = {
										has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
										has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -5
				desc = "from_french_monarchist_rival"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				leader ?= {
					has_variable = caudillo_fascist
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 20
				desc = "caudillo_support"
			}
		}
		# First Past the Post (amendment_first_past_the_post): one of the two
		# largest parties, as te_fptp_effects.txt ranks them monthly. In place
		# of the party-size multipliers (the else_ifs below), so a major party
		# never fills up: each group joining first takes a little off instead.
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					has_variable = te_fptp_major_fascist_party
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_major_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_major_party_join"
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:number > 0 }
				add = {
					value = scope:number
					multiply = te_fptp_major_party_crowding_weight
					desc = "te_fptp_major_party_crowding"
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number = 1
				is_powerful = no
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
				desc = "from_influential_supporting_member"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number = 2
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.5
				desc = "from_two_prior_members"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number >= 3
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.0
				desc = "from_three_or_more_prior_members"
			}
		}
		# First Past the Post: any party but the two largest.
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					NOT = { has_variable = te_fptp_major_fascist_party }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_minor_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_minor_party_join"
			}
		}
	}
}

INJECT:free_trade_party = {
	join_weight = {
		value = {
			value = -5
			desc = "base_value"
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					c:BIC ?= this
					is_subject = yes
					OR = {
						has_modifier = modifier_india_crown_rule
						has_modifier = modifier_india_company_rule
						has_modifier = modifier_india_company_rule_upgraded
					}
				}
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
					is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -100
				desc = "india_colonial_government"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_south_america
					any_primary_culture = {
						has_discrimination_trait = language_hispanophone
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -10
				desc = "south_america_two_party_system"
			}
		}
		# Spain and Portugal have two parties at game start
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_oligarchy
					OR = {
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:spanish
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:portuguese
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -10
				desc = "from_two_party_system"
			}
		}
		if = { # # industrialists/market liberals split from liberals as the economy modernises
			limit = {
				OR = {
					leader ?= {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal
					}
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_plutocratic
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "from_liberal_economy_laws"
				if = {
					limit = {
						owner = {
							OR = {
								has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_laissez_faire
								has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_interventionism
							}
						}
					}
					add = 2
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						owner = {
							OR = {
								has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_free_trade
								has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_protectionism
							}
						}
					}
					add = 1
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						owner = {
							OR = {
								has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_tenant_farmers
								has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_commercialized_agriculture
							}
						}
					}
					add = 1
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						owner = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_slavery_banned
						}
					}
					add = 1
				}
			}
		}
		# powerful capitalists likely to form their own party
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_powerful = yes
				OR = {
					leader ?= {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal
					}
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_plutocratic
				}
				NOT = {
					owner = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_powerful_capitalists"
			}
		}
		# weaker market liberals fall behind powerful industrialists
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_powerful = no
				owner = {
					ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
						is_powerful = yes
					}
				}
				leader ?= {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_powerful_capitalists_other"
			}
		}
		if = { # landowners and industrialists hate labor rights
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_regulatory_bodies
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_worker_protections
					}
				}
				law_enactment_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_no_workers_rights
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_labor_rights"
			}
		}
		if = { # conservatives hate welfare
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_wage_subsidies
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_old_age_pension
					}
				}
				law_enactment_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_poor_laws
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_welfare"
			}
		}
		if = { # capitalists hate children
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_child_labor_allowed }
				}
				law_enactment_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_child_labor_allowed
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_hates_children"
			}
		}
		if = { # capitalists want free trade
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_free_trade }
				}
				law_enactment_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_free_trade
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_no_free_trade"
			}
		}
		if = { # capitalists want to have power
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_oligarchy
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_wealth_voting
					}
				}
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_plutocratic
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_no_oligarchy_wealth_voting"
			}
		}
		if = { # liberal-capitalist anti-autocracy alliance
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_autocracy
				}
				law_enactment_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_wealth_voting
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_autocracy"
			}
		}
		if = { # capitalist-reactionary anti-democracy alliance
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_universal_suffrage"
			}
		}
		if = { # capitalist-meritocratic taxation alliance
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_technology_researched = currency_standards
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation }
				}
				law_enactment_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_no_per_capita_tax"
			}
		}
		if = { # capitalist-conservative taxation alliance
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_graduated_taxation
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_graduated_taxation"
			}
		}
		if = { # opposition to command economy
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_technology_researched = central_planning
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_command_economy
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_command_economy
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_command_economy"
			}
		}
		if = { # pro-private schools
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_technology_researched = academia
					NOT = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_private_schools
					}
				}
				law_enactment_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_private_schools
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_lack_of_private_schools"
			}
		}
		if = { # protectionism bad
			limit = {
				leader ?= {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_protectionist
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -10
				desc = from_protectionist_leader
			}
		}
		if = { # universal suffrage Industrialists - prevents forming of impotent parties
			limit = {
				scope:number <= 1
				is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_census_voting
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "from_late_industrialists"
				if = {
					limit = {
						owner = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
						}
					}
					add = -10
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						owner = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_census_voting
						}
					}
					add = -5
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
				is_powerful = yes
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
				desc = "from_archetype_party"
			}
		}
		# First Past the Post (amendment_first_past_the_post): one of the two
		# largest parties, as te_fptp_effects.txt ranks them monthly. In place
		# of the party-size multipliers (the else_ifs below), so a major party
		# never fills up: each group joining first takes a little off instead.
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					has_variable = te_fptp_major_free_trade_party
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_major_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_major_party_join"
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:number > 0 }
				add = {
					value = scope:number
					multiply = te_fptp_major_party_crowding_weight
					desc = "te_fptp_major_party_crowding"
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number = 1
				is_powerful = no
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
				desc = "from_influential_supporting_member"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number = 2
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.5
				desc = "from_two_prior_members"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number >= 3
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.0
				desc = "from_three_or_more_prior_members"
			}
		}
		if = { # anti-orleanist
			limit = {
				leader ?= {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
					}
				}
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						has_party = yes
						party = {
							is_party_type = free_trade_party
						}
						is_powerful = yes
						leader ?= {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -5
				desc = "from_french_monarchist_rival"
			}
		}
		if = { # anti-legitimist
			limit = {
				leader ?= {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
					}
				}
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						has_party = yes
						party = {
							is_party_type = free_trade_party
						}
						is_powerful = yes
						leader ?= {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -5
				desc = "from_french_monarchist_rival"
			}
		}
		if = { # anti-bonapartist
			limit = {
				leader ?= {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
					}
				}
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						has_party = yes
						party = {
							is_party_type = free_trade_party
						}
						is_powerful = yes
						leader ?= {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -5
				desc = "from_french_monarchist_rival"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:brazilian
					NOT = {
						OR = {
							has_technology_researched = socialism
							has_technology_researched = corporatism
							has_technology_researched = anarchism
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -10
				desc = "from_two_party_system"
			}
		}
		# First Past the Post: any party but the two largest.
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					NOT = { has_variable = te_fptp_major_free_trade_party }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_minor_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_minor_party_join"
			}
		}
	}
}

INJECT:liberal_party = {
	join_weight = {
		value = {
			value = -5
			desc = "base_value"
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					c:BIC ?= this
					is_subject = yes
					OR = {
						has_modifier = modifier_india_crown_rule
						has_modifier = modifier_india_company_rule
						has_modifier = modifier_india_company_rule_upgraded
					}
				}
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
					is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -100
				desc = "india_colonial_government"
			}
		}
		if = { # liberals love liberalism
			limit = {
				leader ?= {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_reformer
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal_leader
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican_leader
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "from_liberal_leader"
				if = {
					limit = {
						leader ?= {
							OR = {
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_reformer
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal_leader
							}
						}
					}
					add = 10
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						leader ?= {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal
						}
					}
					add = 5
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						leader ?= {
							OR = {
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican_leader
								has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
							}
						}
					}
					add = 3
				}
			}
		}
		if = { # various progressives are inclined towards liberalism
			limit = {
				leader ?= {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_feminist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_abolitionist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_pacifist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_humanitarian
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_humanitarian_royalist
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_progressivism"
			}
		}
		if = { # modernizer
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_modernizer # The IG ideology
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_modernizer"
			}
		}
		if = { # various conservatives dislike liberalism
			limit = {
				leader ?= {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_traditionalist
						character_has_carlist_ideology = yes
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_royalist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_theocrat
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_slaver
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_authoritarian
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -5
				desc = "from_conservatism"
			}
		}
		if = { # against hereditary bureacrats
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_hereditary_bureaucrats
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_hereditary_bureaucrats
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_hereditary_offices"
			}
		}
		if = { # for greater suffrage
			limit = {
				law_enactment_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_census_voting
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner ?= {
						has_law = law_type:law_landed_voting
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 5
					desc = "from_increased_suffrage"
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner ?= {
						has_law = law_type:law_wealth_voting
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 3
					desc = "from_increased_suffrage"
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner ?= {
						has_law = law_type:law_census_voting
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 1
					desc = "from_increased_suffrage"
				}
			}
		}
		if = { # armed forces will join if a more powerful member has jingoist leader
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
				exists = owner.py:liberal_party
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						is_member_of_party = owner.py:liberal_party
						is_powerful = yes
						leader ?= {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jingoist_leader
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_jingoist_party_leader"
			}
		}
		# for as long as the Industrialists are not powerful, they'll be more liberal
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_powerful = no
				OR = {
					leader ?= {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal
					}
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_laissez_faire
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_interventionist
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_capitalism"
			}
		}
		# If conservatives [landowners/church] are strong, Industrialists will stay liberal
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
					is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
				}
				owner = {
					OR = {
						ig:ig_landowners ?= {
							is_powerful = yes
						}
						ig:ig_devout ?= {
							is_powerful = yes
						}
					}
				}
				OR = {
					leader ?= {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal
					}
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_laissez_faire
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_interventionist
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "from_powerful_conservatives"
				if = {
					limit = {
						owner = {
							ig:ig_landowners ?= {
								is_powerful = yes
							}
						}
					}
					add = 2
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						owner = {
							ig:ig_devout ?= {
								is_powerful = yes
							}
						}
					}
					add = 2
				}
			}
		}
		if = { # Spanish church will not be liberal
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_pious
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_corporatist
				}
				owner = {
					c:SPA ?= this
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -20
				desc = "from_liberal_anticlericalism"
			}
		}
		if = { # against illiteracy and religious education
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_religious_schools
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_no_schools
					}
				}
				law_enactment_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_private_schools
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_no_or_religious_schools"
			}
		}
		if = { # lack of women's rights
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_no_womens_rights
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_no_womens_rights
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = from_no_womens_rights
			}
		}
		if = { # anti-racism
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_ethnostate
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_national_supremacy
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_racial_segregation
					}
				}
				law_enactment_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_cultural_exclusion
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = from_racism
			}
		}
		if = { # anti-censorship
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_censorship
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
					}
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_censorship
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = from_censorship
			}
		}
		if = { # against arbitrary or militarized policing
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_local_police
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_militarized_police
					}
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_militarized_police
					value < neutral
				}
				law_enactment_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_dedicated_police
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = from_bad_police
			}
		}
		if = { # anticlerical
			limit = {
				law_enactment_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_total_separation
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_anticlerical"
			}
		}
		if = { # republican
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						country_has_monarchy_law = yes
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_theocracy
					}
				}
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_populist
					leader ?= {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican_leader
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_republican"
			}
		}
		if = { # anti-serfdom
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_serfdom
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_serfdom"
			}
		}
		if = { # general anti-slavery
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_legacy_slavery
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_slave_trade
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_colonial_slavery
					}
				}
				law_enactment_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_slavery_banned
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_slavery"
			}
		}
		if = { # early Trade Unions
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				owner = {
					NOT = {
						has_technology_researched = socialism
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "from_early_trade_unions"
				if = {
					limit = {
						owner = {
							OR = {
								has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_landed_voting
								has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_wealth_voting
							}
						}
					}
					add = 10
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						owner = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_census_voting
						}
					}
					add = 5
				}
			}
		}
		# Special weights for ACW
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_journal_entry = je_acw_countdown
						AND = { # JE not active yet at initialization
							c:USA ?= THIS
							year < 1837
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { leader ?= { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_slaver } }
				add = {
					value = -100
					desc = "from_slaver_leader"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { leader ?= { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_abolitionist } }
				add = {
					value = 100
					desc = "from_abolitionist_leader"
				}
			}
		}
		if = { # French Monarchists
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						leader ?= {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
						}
						owner.py:liberal_party ?= {
							any_member = {
								is_powerful = yes
								leader ?= {
									OR = {
										has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
										has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
					AND = {
						leader ?= {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
						}
						owner.py:liberal_party ?= {
							any_member = {
								is_powerful = yes
								leader ?= {
									OR = {
										has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
										has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
					AND = {
						leader ?= {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
						}
						owner.py:liberal_party ?= {
							any_member = {
								is_powerful = yes
								leader ?= {
									OR = {
										has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
										has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -5
				desc = "from_french_monarchist_rival"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					c:FRA ?= this
					has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
					ruler ?= {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
					}
				}
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_universalist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_populist
					leader ?= {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican_leader
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_positivist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_july_monarchy"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_south_america
					any_primary_culture = {
						has_discrimination_trait = language_hispanophone
					}
				}
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
					is_interest_group_type = ig_rural_folk
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "south_america_two_party_system"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:yankee
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:dixie
					}
					OR = {
						NOT = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_slavery_banned
						}
						has_modifier = missouri_compromise
					}
				}
				leader ?= {
					culture = cu:yankee
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					leader ?= {
						has_template = USA_robert_rantoul # Northern Democrat
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = -10
					desc = "from_northern_democrats"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = 3
					desc = "from_northern_interests"
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:yankee
						country_has_primary_culture = cu:dixie
					}
					OR = {
						NOT = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_slavery_banned
						}
						has_modifier = missouri_compromise
					}
				}
				leader ?= {
					culture = cu:dixie
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -5
				desc = "from_southern_interests"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				leader ?= {
					has_variable = caudillo_liberal
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 20
				desc = "caudillo_support"
			}
		}
		if = { # Carlists and Miguelists were against participating in electoral politics for a good while
			limit = {
				NOT = { owner = { has_technology_researched = corporatism } }
				leader ?= { # ?= by the generator: vanilla reads the leader unguarded
					OR = {
						character_has_carlist_ideology = yes
						character_has_miguelist_ideology = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -20
				desc = "from_traditionalist_monarchism"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
				is_powerful = yes
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
				desc = "from_archetype_party"
			}
		}
		# First Past the Post (amendment_first_past_the_post): one of the two
		# largest parties, as te_fptp_effects.txt ranks them monthly. In place
		# of the party-size multipliers (the else_ifs below), so a major party
		# never fills up: each group joining first takes a little off instead.
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					has_variable = te_fptp_major_liberal_party
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_major_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_major_party_join"
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:number > 0 }
				add = {
					value = scope:number
					multiply = te_fptp_major_party_crowding_weight
					desc = "te_fptp_major_party_crowding"
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number <= 1
				is_powerful = no
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
				desc = "from_influential_supporting_member"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number = 2
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.5
				desc = "from_two_prior_members"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number >= 3
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.0
				desc = "from_three_or_more_prior_members"
			}
		}
		# First Past the Post: any party but the two largest.
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					NOT = { has_variable = te_fptp_major_liberal_party }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_minor_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_minor_party_join"
			}
		}
	}
}

INJECT:military_party = {
	join_weight = {
		value = {
			value = -5
			desc = "base_value"
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					c:BIC ?= this
					is_subject = yes
					OR = {
						has_modifier = modifier_india_crown_rule
						has_modifier = modifier_india_company_rule
						has_modifier = modifier_india_company_rule_upgraded
					}
				}
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
					is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -100
				desc = "india_colonial_government"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_south_america
					any_primary_culture = {
						has_discrimination_trait = language_hispanophone
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -10
				desc = "south_america_two_party_system"
			}
		}
		if = { # nobody will join if the armed forces don't join
			limit = {
				scope:founding_party = no
				NOT = { is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces }
				OR = {
					NOT = { exists = owner.py:military_party }
					AND = {
						exists = owner.py:military_party
						owner = {
							ig:ig_armed_forces ?= {
								NOT = { is_member_of_party = owner.py:military_party }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -20
				desc = "from_no_army_in_party" # this should probably never actually display in game because the party won't exist
			}
		}
		if = { # a party for powerful soldiers
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
				is_powerful = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_strong_military"
			}
		}
		if = { # jingoists like the military party
			limit = {
				leader ?= { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jingoist_leader }
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_jingoist"
			}
		}
		if = { # conservatives like police
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_technology_researched = law_enforcement
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_no_police
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_no_police
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_no_police"
			}
		}
		if = { # anti-peasant levies
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_peasant_levies
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_peasant_levies
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_peasant_levies"
			}
		}
		if = { # loyalist/proletarian/meritocratic alliance for tax reform
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					NOT = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_proportional_taxation
					}
				}
				law_enactment_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_lacking_tax_laws"
			}
		}
		# alliance for stricter internal security
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_no_home_affairs
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_guaranteed_liberties
					}
				}
				law_enactment_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_secret_police
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_liberty"
			}
		}
		if = { # conservatives like censorship
			limit = {
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_right_of_assembly
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_protected_speech
					}
				}
				law_enactment_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_censorship
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_no_censorship"
			}
		}
		if = { # authoritarians like militarism
			limit = {
				leader ?= {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_authoritarian
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = from_authoritarian
			}
		}
		if = { # Carlists and Miguelists were against participating in electoral politics for a good while
			limit = {
				NOT = { owner = { has_technology_researched = corporatism } }
				leader ?= { # ?= by the generator: vanilla reads the leader unguarded
					OR = {
						character_has_carlist_ideology = yes
						character_has_miguelist_ideology = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -20
				desc = "from_traditionalist_monarchism"
			}
		}
		if = { # French Monarchists
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						leader ?= {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
						}
						owner.py:military_party ?= {
							any_member = {
								is_powerful = yes
								leader ?= {
									OR = {
										has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
										has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
					AND = {
						leader ?= {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
						}
						owner.py:military_party ?= {
							any_member = {
								is_powerful = yes
								leader ?= {
									OR = {
										has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
										has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
					AND = {
						leader ?= {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
						}
						owner.py:military_party ?= {
							any_member = {
								is_powerful = yes
								leader ?= {
									OR = {
										has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
										has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -5
				desc = "from_french_monarchist_rival"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				leader ?= {
					NOR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal_leader
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican_leader
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist_leader
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
					}
				}
				owner = {
					c:FRA ?= this
					has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -10
				desc = "from_monarchist_leanings"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
				is_powerful = yes
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
				desc = "from_archetype_party"
			}
		}
		# First Past the Post (amendment_first_past_the_post): one of the two
		# largest parties, as te_fptp_effects.txt ranks them monthly. In place
		# of the party-size multipliers (the else_ifs below), so a major party
		# never fills up: each group joining first takes a little off instead.
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					has_variable = te_fptp_major_military_party
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_major_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_major_party_join"
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:number > 0 }
				add = {
					value = scope:number
					multiply = te_fptp_major_party_crowding_weight
					desc = "te_fptp_major_party_crowding"
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number = 1
				is_powerful = no
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
				desc = "from_influential_supporting_member"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number = 2
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.5
				desc = "from_two_prior_members"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number >= 3
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.0
				desc = "from_three_or_more_prior_members"
			}
		}
		# First Past the Post: any party but the two largest.
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					NOT = { has_variable = te_fptp_major_military_party }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_minor_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_minor_party_join"
			}
		}
	}
}

INJECT:radical_party = {
	join_weight = {
		value = {
			value = -5
			desc = "base_value"
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					c:BIC ?= this
					is_subject = yes
					OR = {
						has_modifier = modifier_india_crown_rule
						has_modifier = modifier_india_company_rule
						has_modifier = modifier_india_company_rule_upgraded
					}
				}
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
					is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -100
				desc = "india_colonial_government"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_south_america
					any_primary_culture = {
						has_discrimination_trait = language_hispanophone
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -10
				desc = "south_america_two_party_system"
			}
		}
		if = { # radicals love radicalism
			limit = {
				leader ?= {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_radical"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_powerful = yes
				leader ?= {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 15
				desc = "from_powerful_radical"
			}
		}
		if = { # radicals will fall in line behind stronger liberals
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_egalitarian
					leader ?= {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
					}
				}
				is_powerful = no
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						is_powerful = yes
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_universalist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal_modern
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_universalist_modern
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -5
				desc = "from_weak_radicals"
			}
		}
		if = { # weak liberals will fall in line behind strong radicals
			limit = {
				is_powerful = no
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_universalist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal_modern
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_universalist_modern
				}
				owner = {
					any_interest_group = {
						is_powerful = yes
						leader ?= {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_weak_liberals_radical"
			}
		}
		if = { # weak leftists will fall in line behind radicals pre-revolution
			limit = {
				is_powerful = no
				leader ?= {
					has_socialist_ideology = yes
				}
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic }
					any_interest_group = {
						is_powerful = yes
						leader ?= {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_weak_leftists_radical"
			}
		}
		if = { # various progressives are inclined towards radicalism
			limit = {
				leader ?= {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_feminist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_abolitionist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_state_socialist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican_leader
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_humanitarian
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_progressives_radical"
			}
		}
		if = { # early Trade Unions
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				owner = {
					NOT = {
						has_technology_researched = socialism
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "from_early_trade_unions"
				if = {
					limit = {
						owner = {
							OR = {
								has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_landed_voting
								has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_wealth_voting
							}
						}
					}
					add = 15
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						owner = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_census_voting
						}
					}
					add = 10
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						owner = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
						}
					}
					add = 5
				}
			}
		}
		if = { # republican
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						country_has_monarchy_law = yes
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_theocracy
					}
				}
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_populist
					leader ?= {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican_leader
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_republican"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { # particularists will join in when their issues are relevant
				owner = {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_debt_slavery
					}
				}
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_particularist
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_particularism_cares_about_laws"
			}
		}
		if = { # moderates are scared of radical politics
			limit = {
				NOT = { is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions }
				leader ?= {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_moderate
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -3
				desc = "from_moderate"
			}
		}
		if = { # from lack of democracy
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_universal_suffrage }
				}
				law_enactment_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_no_universal_suffrage"
			}
		}
		if = { # anti-censorship
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_censorship
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
					}
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_censorship
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = from_censorship
			}
		}
		if = { # opposition to secret police
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_secret_police
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_secret_police
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 6
				desc = from_bad_home_affairs
			}
		}
		if = { # general anti-slavery
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_legacy_slavery
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_slave_trade
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_colonial_slavery
					}
				}
				law_enactment_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_slavery_banned
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_slavery"
			}
		}
		if = { # anti-serfdom
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_serfdom
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_serfdom"
			}
		}
		# First Past the Post (amendment_first_past_the_post): one of the two
		# largest parties, as te_fptp_effects.txt ranks them monthly. In place
		# of the party-size multipliers (the else_ifs below), so a major party
		# never fills up: each group joining first takes a little off instead.
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					has_variable = te_fptp_major_radical_party
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_major_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_major_party_join"
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:number > 0 }
				add = {
					value = scope:number
					multiply = te_fptp_major_party_crowding_weight
					desc = "te_fptp_major_party_crowding"
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number = 1
				is_powerful = no
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
				desc = "from_influential_supporting_member"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number = 2
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.5
				desc = "from_two_prior_members"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number >= 3
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.0
				desc = "from_three_or_more_prior_members"
			}
		}
		# First Past the Post: any party but the two largest.
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					NOT = { has_variable = te_fptp_major_radical_party }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_minor_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_minor_party_join"
			}
		}
	}
}

INJECT:religious_party = {
	join_weight = {
		value = {
			value = -5
			desc = "base_value"
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					c:BIC ?= this
					is_subject = yes
					OR = {
						has_modifier = modifier_india_crown_rule
						has_modifier = modifier_india_company_rule
						has_modifier = modifier_india_company_rule_upgraded
					}
				}
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
					is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -100
				desc = "india_colonial_government"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_south_america
					any_primary_culture = {
						has_discrimination_trait = language_hispanophone
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -10
				desc = "south_america_two_party_system"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = {
						has_technology_researched = corporatism
					}
					any_interest_group = {
						is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners
						ig_counts_as_marginal = no
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -5
				desc = "from_relevant_landowners"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_theocracy
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_theocracy
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_theocracy"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				leader ?= { # ?= by the generator: vanilla reads the leader unguarded
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
				}
				owner = {
					country_has_primary_culture = cu:french
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 20
				desc = "ideology_legitimist"
			}
		}
		if = { # nobody will join if the devout don't join
			limit = {
				scope:founding_party = no
				NOT = { is_interest_group_type = ig_devout }
				OR = {
					NOT = { exists = owner.py:religious_party }
					AND = {
						exists = owner.py:religious_party
						owner = {
							ig:ig_devout ?= {
								NOT = { is_member_of_party = owner.py:religious_party }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -20
				desc = "from_no_devout_in_party" # this should probably never actually display in game because the party won't exist
			}
		}
		if = { # a party for powerful religious people
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
				is_powerful = yes
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_powerful_devout"
			}
		}
		if = { # religiously inclined people might join if devout are powerful
			limit = {
				is_powerful = no
				owner = {
					ig:ig_devout ?= {
						is_powerful = yes
					}
				}
				leader ?= {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_traditionalist
						character_has_carlist_ideology = yes
						character_has_miguelist_ideology = yes
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_theocrat
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_corporatist_leader
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_powerful_devout_other"
			}
		}
		if = { # antireligious characters and IG's will never join
			limit = {
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_total_separation
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -15
				desc = "from_antireligious"
			}
		}
		if = { # Corporatism
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_corporatist
					leader ?= {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_corporatist_leader
					}
				}
				NOT = {
					c:AUS ?= owner
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = "from_corporatism"
			}
		}
		if = { # patriarchs more likely to join conservatives with women's suffrage
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_womens_suffrage
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_womens_suffrage
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_patriarchy"
			}
		}
		if = { # Carlists and Miguelists were against participating in electoral politics for a good while
			limit = {
				NOT = { owner = { has_technology_researched = corporatism } }
				leader ?= { # ?= by the generator: vanilla reads the leader unguarded
					OR = {
						character_has_carlist_ideology = yes
						character_has_miguelist_ideology = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -20
				desc = "from_traditionalist_monarchism"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
				is_powerful = yes
				NOT = {
					c:AUS ?= owner
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
				desc = "from_archetype_party"
			}
		}
		if = { # French Monarchists
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						leader ?= {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
						}
						owner.py:religious_party ?= {
							any_member = {
								is_powerful = yes
								leader ?= {
									OR = {
										has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
										has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
					AND = {
						leader ?= {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
						}
						owner.py:religious_party ?= {
							any_member = {
								is_powerful = yes
								leader ?= {
									OR = {
										has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
										has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
					AND = {
						leader ?= {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_orleanist
						}
						owner.py:religious_party ?= {
							any_member = {
								is_powerful = yes
								leader ?= {
									OR = {
										has_ideology = ideology:ideology_bonapartist
										has_ideology = ideology:ideology_legitimist
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -5
				desc = "from_french_monarchist_rival"
			}
		}
		# First Past the Post (amendment_first_past_the_post): one of the two
		# largest parties, as te_fptp_effects.txt ranks them monthly. In place
		# of the party-size multipliers (the else_ifs below), so a major party
		# never fills up: each group joining first takes a little off instead.
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					has_variable = te_fptp_major_religious_party
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_major_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_major_party_join"
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:number > 0 }
				add = {
					value = scope:number
					multiply = te_fptp_major_party_crowding_weight
					desc = "te_fptp_major_party_crowding"
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number = 1
				is_powerful = no
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
				desc = "from_influential_supporting_member"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number = 2
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.5
				desc = "from_two_prior_members"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number >= 3
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.0
				desc = "from_three_or_more_prior_members"
			}
		}
		# First Past the Post: any party but the two largest.
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					NOT = { has_variable = te_fptp_major_religious_party }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_minor_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_minor_party_join"
			}
		}
	}
}

INJECT:socialist_party = {
	join_weight = {
		value = {
			value = -5
			desc = "base_value"
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					c:BIC ?= this
					is_subject = yes
					OR = {
						has_modifier = modifier_india_crown_rule
						has_modifier = modifier_india_company_rule
						has_modifier = modifier_india_company_rule_upgraded
					}
				}
				OR = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists
					is_interest_group_type = ig_armed_forces
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -100
				desc = "india_colonial_government"
			}
		}
		if = { # communists love socialism if not reformist
			limit = {
				had_reformist_socialism_victory = no
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_internationalist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_defensist
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 50
				desc = "from_communist_ig"
			}
		}
		if = { # generic Trade Unions party
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_proletarian
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						had_reformist_socialism_victory = no
					}
					leader ?= {
						NOR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist_leader
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = from_proletarian
			}
		}
		if = { # generic powerful Trade Unions party
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_proletarian
				is_powerful = yes
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						had_reformist_socialism_victory = no
					}
					leader ?= {
						NOR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist_leader
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = from_powerful_unions
			}
		}
		if = { # social democrats love social democracy
			limit = {
				had_revolutionary_socialism_victory = no
				leader ?= {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_state_socialist
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = from_social_democrat
			}
		}
		if = { # powerful social democrats love social democracy
			limit = {
				had_revolutionary_socialism_victory = no
				is_powerful = yes
				leader ?= {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_state_socialist
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = from_social_democrat_powerful
			}
		}
		if = { # communists love communism
			limit = {
				had_reformist_socialism_victory = no
				leader ?= {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist_leader
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 15
				desc = "from_communism"
			}
		}
		if = { # weak leftists will fall in line behind social democrats pre-revolution
			limit = {
				had_reformist_socialism_victory = no
				is_powerful = no
				leader ?= {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist_leader
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
					}
				}
				owner ?= {
					has_technology_researched = political_agitation
					NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic }
					any_interest_group = {
						is_powerful = yes
						leader ?= {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_state_socialist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = 6
			desc = from_weak_communists
		}
		# weak liberals might fall in line behind strong social democrats
		if = {
			limit = {
				had_revolutionary_socialism_victory = no
				is_powerful = no
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_universalist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal_modern
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_universalist_modern
				}
				owner ?= {
					any_interest_group = {
						is_powerful = yes
						leader ?= {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_state_socialist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = from_weak_liberals
			}
		}
		if = { # various progressives are inclined towards social democracy
			limit = {
				had_revolutionary_socialism_victory = no
				leader ?= {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_feminist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_abolitionist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican_leader
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_humanitarian
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_humanitarian_royalist
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = from_progressivism_sd
			}
		}
		# market liberals not very inclined to join social democrats
		if = {
			limit = {
				leader ?= {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = -5
				desc = from_marked_liberal_sd
			}
		}
		if = { # anti-censorship
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_censorship
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_outlawed_dissent
					}
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_censorship
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = from_censorship
			}
		}
		if = { # against land-based taxation
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_land_based_taxation
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_land_tax"
			}
		}
		if = { # republican
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						country_has_monarchy_law = yes
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_theocracy
					}
				}
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_populist
					leader ?= {
						OR = {
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_nihilist
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican_leader
							has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_republican"
			}
		}
		if = { # against illiteracy and religious education
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_religious_schools
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_no_schools
					}
				}
				law_enactment_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_public_schools
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_no_or_religious_schools"
			}
		}
		if = { # against free trade - peasant/socialist alliance
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_free_trade
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_free_trade
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_anti_free_trade"
			}
		}
		if = { # against laissez-faire - peasant/socialist alliance
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_laissez_faire
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_laissez_faire
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_anti_laissez_faire"
			}
		}
		if = { # loyalist-proletarian alliance for tax reform
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					NOT = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_graduated_taxation
					}
				}
				law_enactment_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 3
				desc = "from_no_graduated_taxation"
			}
		}
		if = { # anti-serfdom
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_serfdom
				}
				law_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_serfdom
					value < neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_serfdom"
			}
		}
		if = { # general anti-slavery
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_legacy_slavery
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_slave_trade
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_colonial_slavery
					}
				}
				law_enactment_stance = {
					law = law_type:law_slavery_banned
					value > neutral
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = "from_slavery"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				is_powerful = yes
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
				desc = "from_archetype_party"
			}
		}
		# First Past the Post (amendment_first_past_the_post): one of the two
		# largest parties, as te_fptp_effects.txt ranks them monthly. In place
		# of the party-size multipliers (the else_ifs below), so a major party
		# never fills up: each group joining first takes a little off instead.
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					has_variable = te_fptp_major_socialist_party
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_major_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_major_party_join"
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:number > 0 }
				add = {
					value = scope:number
					multiply = te_fptp_major_party_crowding_weight
					desc = "te_fptp_major_party_crowding"
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number = 1
				is_powerful = no
				ig_counts_as_marginal = no
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
				desc = "from_influential_supporting_member"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number = 2
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.5
				desc = "from_two_prior_members"
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:number >= 3
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.0
				desc = "from_three_or_more_prior_members"
			}
		}
		# First Past the Post: any party but the two largest.
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					te_fptp_in_force = yes
					has_variable = te_fptp_two_majors
					NOT = { has_variable = te_fptp_major_socialist_party }
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = te_fptp_minor_party_join_weight
				desc = "te_fptp_minor_party_join"
			}
		}
	}
}
